patterns: What is an iPad?
What media does an iPad support?
Who created the iPad?
How big is an iPad?
What software runs an iPad?
Can an iPad run iPhone apps?
What liberties does an iPad give its users?
responses: The iPad is a line of tablet computers created and marketed by Apple Inc., sized between a laptop and a smartphone. It runs the same software as the iPod Touch and iPhone, meaning it can run all iPhone applications. It acts as a platform for AV media and gives users the liberty to move around and conveniently manage their social media, online business, and office connectivity.
